releaseProcedure: Use a DER-controlled code-signing certificate with the Code Signing EKU and a private key.
Add the certificate thumbprint to the release signing policy before package-manifest generation.
Authenticode-sign all runtime PowerShell files and timestamp each signature.
Generate the package manifest after child files are signed; embed its SHA-256 in the parent trust anchor; then sign the parent last.
Regenerate SHA256SUMS.txt and run Tools/Test-DERPackage.ps1 -RequireSigned before distribution.
